title: NRO Program B ground element at Pine Gap

tellings.quote: the ground element of NRO program B was established at Pineap Australia.

plain: The ground part of "Program B", a branch of the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, was set up at Pine Gap, a facility in Australia, sometime in the 1980s. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb (UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the newer official term for UFOs) says this on the show and mentions the name R. Evans Heinman alongside it, without giving a document. If true, a secret American space programme kept part of its operation on Australian soil.
